details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:480-489 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `test_config_contract` reads `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (CONFIG = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "ai" / "chatgpt_pool.json", line 30), but that file does not exist on the current ref or in the PR, so line 481 raises FileNotFoundError.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated this BLOCKER, so they agree on severity. On head 9fb1872512f2 the CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails at the "ChatGPT pool token action tests" step (1 failed, 49 passed), which also fails the aggregate lint job. In production, scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh defaults CHATGPT_POOL_CONFIG to ${script_dir}/../.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json, so every call would return available=false reason=config_missing.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #8970, requirement 3: "Add `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (broker URL, audience, etc., per the plan) with `reviewer_slot_enabled: false`. Do not set it to true; go-live is a separate human PR."
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file, listed in the issue's files_touched grant)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The file is not in pr_changed_files.txt, no PR diff hunk creates it, and it is not in the working tree. CI on head 9fb1872512f2c925b68abaa3cba9eebd2dc5403b fails with `FAILED tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py::test_config_contract - FileNotFoundError` at tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:481, which turns the aggregate lint job red. `scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:32` defaults CHATGPT_POOL_CONFIG to this path, so without it every job gets reason=config_missing. The contract test pins the content: schema_version=1, broker_url="https://claude-pool-broker.shubhodeep.workers.dev/v1/chatgpt", audience="coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool" (equal to CHATGPT_AUDIENCE), reviewer_slot_enabled=false. Three earlier autofix runs deferred the file because the editor sandbox excludes the path. Every reviewer rated it BLOCKER.
- requirement: Plan Phase 1 steps 1-2 (docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md lines 288-329; the issue says the plan's names, endpoint paths, JSON keys, storage design and file list win):
  - a CHATGPT_ACCOUNTS Durable Object (class ChatgptAccount), one instance per account;
  - wrangler vars CHATGPT_GATE="0.9", CHATGPT_WRITER_REPOSITORY="shubhodeep1/claude-workers" and CHATGPT_WRITER_WORKFLOW="chatgpt-pool-refresh.yml";
  - POST /v1/chatgpt returning {account, auth_json} with tokens.refresh_token removed, choosing the lowest weekly usage account, or 503 chatgpt_pool_empty;
  - GET /v1/chatgpt/status;
  - GET/PUT /v1/chatgpt/refresh/<NAME> with a writer OIDC check (audience coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool-writer), 404 not_seeded, reseed by seed_sha256, and CAS on base_generation (409 generation_conflict).
  expected_change_site: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts (router in createHandler plus the ChatgptAccount DO), tools/claude-pool-broker/wrangler.toml, tools/claude-pool-broker/test/broker.test.ts
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR builds a single-credential ChatgptPoolStore instead: bound as CHATGPT_POOL, seeded from CHATGPT_POOL_SEED, and refreshing inside the broker through CHATGPT_REFRESH_URL/CHATGPT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID (`tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:60-69`, `index.ts:813-857`), which the plan rejects. The router accepts only /v1/pool and /v1/chatgpt (`src/index.ts:636-647` / `src/index.ts:639-647`). The DO answers only POST /grant (`src/index.ts:1016-1022`), and a test asserts that "/v1/chatgpt/grant" returns 404. `wrangler.toml:25-29` has only the CHATGPT_POOL binding and none of CHATGPT_ACCOUNTS, ChatgptAccount, CHATGPT_GATE, CHATGPT_WRITER_REPOSITORY or CHATGPT_WRITER_WORKFLOW. There is no status route, refresh route, writer audience, repo/workflow check, CAS, gate, usage selection, or tests for any of these. The response is {access_token, id_token, account_id, expires_at}, not {account, auth_json}. The already-built claude-workers chatgpt_pool_refresh.py would get 404 not_found. Reviewer severities differ: BLOCKER from gemini, minimax and luna; MAJOR from sonnet and glm.
- requirement: Plan Phase 1 step 4: ".github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/ ... modes `token` (writes `$RUNNER_TEMP/chatgpt-pool/<NAME>/auth.json`, mode 0600) and `status` (outputs `status` JSON, no token); outputs `available`, `reason`, `account`, `codex_home`".
  expected_change_site: .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/action.yml, main.js, post.js, scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `action.yml:11-27` declares only the input config_path and the outputs available, reason, auth_dir, auth_file and expires_at. There is no mode input and no account, codex_home or status output. `scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:12` writes a flat auth.json, not one per <NAME>, and has no status-mode path (`scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:12-14, 190-245`). Phase 2 (review_autofix.yml) and Phase 4 (orchestrate_poll.yml mode: status) depend on status mode. The Phase 1 Done signal available=false reason=broker_refused_chatgpt_pool_empty cannot occur: `scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:225-228` maps every non-403 status to broker_unavailable_<code>, and the broker never emits chatgpt_pool_empty. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- requirement: Plan Phase 1 steps 2 and 5 (plan lines 308-311 and 335-336): reads keep the existing coding-workflows OIDC check, trusted refs and audience `coding-workflows-claude-pool`, and the test checks "that every workflow using the action is in ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES"; the writer audience coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool-writer is the only new constant.
  expected_change_site: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts (handleChatgpt verify/authorize arguments), tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py::test_broker_chatgpt_allowlist_matches_action_users
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: handleChatgpt (`tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:586-595`) calls verify(match[1], CHATGPT_AUDIENCE) with CHATGPT_AUDIENCE="coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool". It calls authorize against a separate CHATGPT_ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES that is empty (`src/index.ts:140-145`, `src/index.ts:142`). `tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:492-505` compares against CHATGPT_ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES, which makes the test tautological while the list is empty. The config contract test also expects the separate audience (`tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:487-491`). The deviation fails closed, so it carries no security risk. One mitigating point: the issue's repo-facts bullet ("a new endpoint needs its own allowlist and contract test, unless the plan says it reuses this one") leaves room for interpretation. Reviewer severities differ: NIT (confidence 3) from sonnet, gemini and glm; MAJOR from minimax (confidence 4) and luna (confidence 5).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
